items.title: Older Nvidia Chips Just Cost Oracle Its Microsoft AI Deal
items.summary: Microsoft is quietly switching off the AI servers it rented from Oracle, and Oracle insists its aging GPUs still command a premium. Which story holds up, and what does it mean for a stock already down by half?

items.title: The Artificial Intelligence (AI) Boom Is Far From Over. Here Are 4 Potential Long-Term Winners
items.summary: The bullish case for these companies continues to get stronger.

items.title: Apple Completes the Set: Every Magnificent Seven Stock Opts Out of OKX-ICE Venue
items.summary: Apple and Meta’s objections mean all seven of the biggest U.S. tech companies have now asked to keep their shares off the planned OKX-ICE venue.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Market Needs Repair But Apple, Amazon, Microsoft Strong; Berkshire Doubles Stock Buyback
items.summary: The stock market needs repair while Sandisk and Micron seem broken. Apple, Amazon and Microsoft are holding up. Berkshire earnings fell.

items.title: AI Stocks Diverge as Democratic Election Victory Sparks Rotation Into Cloud Giants
items.summary: US technology stocks experienced a significant shift in investor positioning on Wednesday, as the Democratic Party’s election victory raised concerns about potential restrictions on new data centre developments. Investors moved toward established cloud computing companies while reducing exposure to semiconductor manufacturers and AI infrastructure developers.

items.title: CoreWeave’s Bonds Now Yield More Than 16%, Days Before Earnings
items.summary: Credit markets and stock analysts are telling opposite stories about CoreWeave, and only one can be right. A single earnings report on November 10 will decide which side has misread a company that still needs tens of billions to build.

items.title: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Just Issued a 6-Word Warning That Could Spell Disaster for AI Stocks
items.summary: Two AI stocks lost nearly half their value in a month while Microsoft barely moved. The split has less to do with chips than with one question every data center builder now has to answer, and rising rates are forcing the issue.

items.title: OpenAI Just Raised $11 Billion at a $1.25 Trillion Valuation, Below the $1.4 Trillion It First Sought
items.summary: OpenAI got its money, but not on the terms it wanted, and the gap between its growth story and investor appetite is landing on two giants. One faces a bookkeeping hit, the other a deeper dependency on the funding flow.
